The '''Ka'Dedus system''' contained [[Af'El/Legends|Af'El]], which was the only [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] capable of sustaining life. Its [[Star/Legends|primary]] was the [[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]] supergiant [[Ka'Dedus]]. All six of the planets in the system were gaseous, high-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] worlds.
